metadata.title: Coarse Embeddings Beyond Doubling: Persistence Diagrams and Multiparameter Modules
metadata.abstract: We study coarse embeddings into Hilbert space and the asymptotic dimension of spaces of persistence diagrams and multiparameter persistence modules. We replace doubling, the usual hypothesis for landmark embeddings, by admissible tent covers of bounded multiplicity at every scale: stacking them across dyadic scales gives an explicit $1$-Lipschitz coarse embedding, with lower gauge $c\sqrt{\tau t}$, or nearly linear for slowly decaying weights, and the same covers bound the asymptotic dimension by the multiplicity. The spaces of persistence diagrams are not doubling but carry such covers, and for diagrams with $n$ points our covers improve the constant of the known landmark embedding by a factor exponential in $n$. Slice by slice, the construction embeds multiparameter modules with boundedly many bars per slice under the matching distance on any finite net of slices, a class that contains the modules with at most $n$ generators. Bounding bars or persistent Betti numbers instead of generators fails: two-parameter modules with one bar on every slice have infinite asymptotic dimension, and neither they nor the modules of bounded support and bounded rank admit a coarse embedding into Hilbert space, under the matching or the interleaving distance.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 非doubling持久同调空间的Hilbert粗嵌入
analysis.workSummary: 以每尺度有界重数的admissible tent covers代替doubling假设，跨二进尺度堆叠得到显式1-Lipschitz Hilbert粗嵌入，具有c√(τt)下控制，慢衰减权时接近线性，并由覆盖重数控制渐近维数。对n点持久图改进landmark嵌入常数，因子随n指数增长；还在有限slice网的matching距离下嵌入每slice条数有界的多参数模。
analysis.breakthrough: 同时给正面嵌入与负面障碍：仅控条数/持久Betti数不足，某些每slice一条的二维参数模有无限渐近维数且不粗嵌入Hilbert。
analysis.limitations: 正面模结论使用有限slice网及每slice有限条数，不能与全slice matching距离或负面类混同；有界生成元与仅有界条数不是同一限制。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
